**"Decommissioned," "Permanently Terminated," or "Removed from Service."**

If your system has a specific "decommissioning protocol" or a specific "Termination Report," that is what you should search for.

Since you cannot provide the specific log, I have identified the most likely legal/technical phrases that represent the official 'end of service' for a specific circuit:**

*   **"Decommissioned"**
*   **"Permanently Terminated"**
*   **"Permanently Disconnected"**

If you can provide any existing standard phrase from the old 1997 logs, I can cross-reference those keywords against the logbook entries to identify the exact phrase you are looking for.**"
